chars.NEIGHBOUR: a 30-year-old French-Moroccan woman with long wavy chestnut hair, natural face without makeup, light freckles, round thin wire glasses, wearing an olive-green military-style shirt jacket over a cream t-shirt and loose khaki cargo trousers
chars.BOY: a 16-year-old Moroccan boy with short curly black hair, wearing a red-and-white horizontally striped polo shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.WOMEN: two Moroccan women in their fifties wearing patterned djellabas and colourful headscarves

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a half-open apartment doorway on the landing below: the NEIGHBOUR walks down the tiled stairwell of an old Casablanca apartment building, head-to-waist framing, face visible, a stack of old French paperback books pressed to her chest, looking ahead silently with a calm, mysterious expression. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, warm afternoon light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: On the stairwell landing, the NEIGHBOUR gives a short polite nod while passing the BOY, who stands frozen against the wall holding a plastic shopping bag, eyes wide, nervous. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, morning light from a stairwell window.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The NEIGHBOUR walks along a narrow popular Moroccan derb street lined with painted doors, carrying a long narrow wooden case on her shoulder and French novels under her arm, reading one book while walking. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, golden late-afternoon light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In front of the apartment building entrance, the NEIGHBOUR types on a tiny old grey push-button mobile phone, while the BOY in the background holds a shiny modern smartphone and stares at her old phone, puzzled. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The NEIGHBOUR steps out of the building in her olive military-style clothes, while the WOMEN stand in a doorway across the narrow derb, leaning together and whispering behind their hands, staring at her with raised eyebrows. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, comic gossip mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: On a Moroccan rooftop terrace with laundry lines and satellite dishes, the BOY sits on a plastic chair secretly reading a thick French novel with intense concentration, a French dictionary open next to him, glancing up toward the upstairs window. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, evening light.
